Return (route, vehicle) for the usable route with the smallest (km, id) — matching best_route's ordering (R3) — which sends a truck whenever a truck may use every road on that route, or None if no route is usable. (2) rerouted_sites(network=None): load the network when None; for each route entry in network['routes'] take warehouse = r['from'] and site = r['to'], compare the route chosen by best_route(warehouse, site, network) with the route chosen by passable_route(warehouse, site, network); collect the site id when the chosen routes differ (a vehicle-only change does not count, per the ticket), dedupe, and return the site ids in name (sorted) order.", "uses": ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R10"], "after": ["P1"]}, {"id": "P3", "file": "notifications/sms.py", "change": "Add notify_rerouted(sites, day) -> list[SmsMessage]. Return the list of queued SmsMessage objects.", "uses": ["R6", "R7", "R8", "R10"], "after": []}, {"id": "P4", "file": "distribution/planner.py", "change": "In build_plan, replace the per-household call best_route(warehouse, hh.site, network) with passable_route(warehouse, hh.site, network) (R9).
